column1: #mapping_set_description: Manually curated subject-side mappings from FIX Simple Binary Encoding (SBE) LinkML entities to FIX Orchestra LinkML entities. Each SBE class / enum is mapped to its closest Orchestra metamodel counterpart using SKOS mapping predicates. Per-version (V1, V2) and cross-version (unsuffixed common) SBE entities are mapped independently when they exist on both sides. Generated as part of the fix-simple-binary-encoding LinkML project; mappings cover only entities with a defensible semantic correspondence and intentionally omit SBE encoding-only entities (byte order, alignment / offset attribute groups, qualified-name pattern types, etc.) for which no Orchestra counterpart exists.

SBE BlockType groups a fixed-layout set of named fields; Orchestra ComponentType groups field / group references in a reusable block. Structural intent matches at the encoding-time vs design-time boundary.
Same as the v1.0 mapping; v2.0 BlockType additionally exposes offset / primitive-type mixin attributes but the core concept is unchanged.
A single named choice within an SBE SetType (bitset). Corresponds to a single CodeType within an Orchestra CodeSetType.
Composite encoding (a sequence of member encodings) maps to a structured Orchestra Datatype with mapped sub-datatypes.
Same as v1.0; v2.0 differs by holding MemberDataType / RefType children rather than inline simpleType / enumType definitions.
v1.0 EncodedDataType (single-encoding datatype declaration) is the SBE counterpart of an Orchestra Datatype definition.
Enumerated set of permissible (valid) values; equivalent to an Orchestra CodeSetType.
Same as v1.0.
Both define a FIX field with id, name, type, and semantic attributes. Same shared name and near-identical conceptual model.
Same as v1.0; v2.0 keeps the same shape with minor attribute-group changes.
SBE GroupType is a repeating block of fields. Orchestra models repeating groups as Components carrying group semantics (no top-level GroupType class).
Same as v1.0.
v2.0 MemberDataType is a sub-element of a CompositeDataType; semantically narrower than a top-level Orchestra Datatype definition.
Both are top-level container roots, but an Orchestra Repository carries substantially more (workflow, scenarios, sessions, actors) than an SBE MessageSchema.
Same as v1.0.
Both define a FIX message at the metamodel level (name, id, msgType, member fields).
Container element holding message definitions; equivalent on both sides.
Same enumeration concept (required / optional / constant / etc.). Permissible-value sets overlap heavily across SBE and Orchestra.
SBE PrimitiveType enumerates encoding-level primitives (uint8, int16, double, ...). Broader than Orchestra Datatype which is itself defined in terms of mapped primitives.
Same as v1.0.
Reference-by-name to a previously-defined type / field, matching Orchestra FieldRefType reference semantics.
Same as v1.0.
SBE SetType is a bitset of named choices; closest Orchestra analog is a multi-value CodeSetType.
Same as v1.0.
v2.0 single-encoding datatype declaration; SBE successor to v1.0 EncodedDataType.
Container element holding datatype definitions; equivalent on both sides.
A single permissible value within an SBE EnumType; equivalent to an Orchestra CodeType within a CodeSetType.
Added / updated / deprecated version-tracking attribute group; Orchestra exposes equivalent metadata through EntityAttribGrp.
